what_this_is: Locate the recorded 4.125 attention BPW floor, identify its metric, and if the codec fit was weight-space, re-fit grouped-absmax in function space on real activations at sub-4.125 budgets.

located.claim: Attention GEMVs cannot be cheaply compressed below uniform-Q4 at Q4-equivalent output quality. Existing Gravity expert families (HGRAVB01 / HGRAVR02 / HGRAVS01) do not transfer. The only cheap Q4-quality action on the 86-88% mass is: (1) on mixed-1p5, drop attention+lm_head from Q8 to Q4 (they were over-protected); (2) lm_head Q3 is cosine-legal but top-1-risky and needs a generate test. Q3 on the attention mass fails the 0.99 bar, especially out_proj.
located.quality_bound_primary: mean row output cosine >= 0.990 vs BF16 W on real captured X (Qwen3.8 Q4 vs bf16 min cosine is 0.98948)
located.quality_bound_not_used: expert organ bar 0.8604 — attention is HIGH sensitivity

activation_honesty.qwen38: activation-capture-v1, 256 tokens, CAPTURED_REAL_BF16_POST_NORM_HIDDEN width 5120. Schema name says post_swiglu but stored width is hidden, not 17408.

located.hadamard_quality_quote: q4 ~matches uniform Q4 at 4.125 vs 4.250 BPW. 2.9% save, not the mass.

qwen38_if_q3_all_attention_rejected.why: out_proj Q3 cosine 0.953 (L0, kurtosis 149) / 0.968 (L32). in_proj Q3 0.975-0.980. Not a Q4-quality pack.

metric_identification.paraphrase_under_attack: Q4 g=128 MSE at 4.125, weight space
metric_identification.4.125_arithmetic: 4 code bits + 16-bit scale / group 128 = 4.125 BPW. SCALE OVERHEAD, not a measured MSE.
metric_identification.4.125_codec_on_probe: HGRAVH01_hadamard_q4_g128 (Walsh-Hadamard then grouped RTN). Not uniform Q4 g=128, not shipping.
metric_identification.gate: mean row output cosine >= 0.990 vs BF16 W on real captured X. NOT MSE. NOT the expert bar 0.8604.
metric_identification.eval_space: function-space (output cosine / rel_l2 of Y=X@W.T on real X, even/odd hold split, n=256 for qwen38)
metric_identification.fit_space_of_codecs_that_set_the_floor: weight-space. HGRAVU01 encoder is grouped-absmax RTN of W, no X. HGRAVH01 is an in-register Hadamard of W then the same RTN. A weak function-space variant HGRAVU01_*_act_colscale (column RMS of real X, then RTN) LOST to weight-space RTN on 8/8 tabulated GQA tensors. HGRAVS01 (act-weighted rSVD, true function-space low-rank) recorded 0 clears of 0.99 at ranks whose BPW beats Q4.
metric_identification.proceed_reason: The quality GATE was already function-space, so the paraphrase 'measured as Q4 g=128 MSE' is false. The CODECS that produced the Q3-fail / 4.125-floor numbers were nevertheless weight-space RTN. That is the method this project's own science says is weakest in the aggressive-low-information regime the floor sits in. Re-fit the same grouped-absmax payload against ||X(W-W_hat)||.

capture.source_note: Phase-B capture_diverse2: real BF16 parent MLX full-model forward, 11269 tokens, 6 families, last 3 prompts/family held out. Not Gaussian. Not Q5_K llama-server. Density probe used 256-row activation-capture-v1; this capture is larger and the same honesty class.
capture.site_caveat: Wrong residual point for in-proj (post_attn_norm, not input_layernorm). Real distribution. Known-invalid class is Gaussian-proxy; this is not that.

scale_trap.pass_if: cosine~1 and gain~0.01 and rel_fro~0.99. GO uses rel_fro+gain+0.99-cosine, never cosine alone.

The contract phrase 'Q4 g=128 MSE at 4.125' overstates the receipt. 4.125 is 4 + 16/128 scale overhead. The probe's 4.125 rows are HGRAVH01_hadamard_q4_g128. The gate is output cosine 0.99 on real X, not MSE.

HGRAVU01_*_act_colscale (column RMS of real X, then RTN) already existed on the density probe and LOST to weight-space RTN on 8 tabulated GQA tensors — a weak function-space variant is not a missing experiment, it is a recorded negative. This probe asks a stronger question (Hessian / GPTQ).

HGRAVS01 (act-weighted rSVD, true function-space) recorded 0 clears of 0.99 at ranks whose BPW beats Q4. Function-space of a *different* operator already failed; this probe is function-space of the *same* grouped-absmax payload.

A local GEMV win is not a composed GQA win. Composed eval on hold sequences is reported separately. Per-tensor ||X(W-W_hat)|| cannot see 6-way K/V sharing (repeat is an isometry of the linear k/v loss).
Raw activation cosine has a family-null near 0.898. Every hold cosine here is paired with a measured constant-mean null of *that GEMV's Y*, not the folklore number.

Storage BPW is fused-active BPW for this codec family (CHEAP_INREGISTER). decoded-f16 active is 16 b/elem and is reported so a materialize kernel cannot be mistaken for a byte win (Q80 0.6462 stored vs 2.518 active).
223 components already measured below 0.5 local BPW with zero healthy. Every BPW in this receipt is paired with HEALTHY/UNHEALTHY against the 0.990 bar.

fs_hess beat ws_rtn on hold rel_fro in ALL 60 matched rows. The function-space scale objective works. It still does not put the attention mass over 0.990 at Q3 (L3 q_proj hess Q3 = 0.9895, the closest miss).
fs_gptq beat ws_rtn on hold rel_fro in only 14/60 matched rows. The 'function space wins in aggressive low-information regimes' result from other organs did not transfer as a floor-mover here.

Composed GQA prefill on hold sequences fails the 0.990 bar even at shipping Q4 g64 on at least one layer (L63 ws_rtn composed Q4 cosine=0.9869, L63 fs_gptq composed Q4 cosine=0.9891). A local GEMV win (including the incumbent) is not a composed win.
Hessian made L63 k_proj Q4 g=128 HEALTHY (WS was 0.9887, under the bar). That unblocks uniform Q4 g128 at the GQA organ — the same 2.9% Hadamard already sold, not a descent through 4.125.
GPTQ unlocked L3 o_proj at 3.25 locally. Composed GQA at Q3 still fails and GPTQ composed is worse than WS. A local o_proj win is not an organ floor.
